_about: Which PRs get which review layers (ways-of-work-lean-pass D5/D7). reviewScope: 'every-pr' = the fresh reviewer + one external general pass on every non-trivial PR; 'security-paths-only' = only when a securityPaths glob is touched (or the body declares risk: high). securityPaths ALSO decides the lean external security lens in every scope. TEMPLATE FILL-IN: replace these globs with your project's real money/auth/migration paths. NOTE: a basename glob like `**/*webhook*` matches a FILE named for it; in an App Router every route file is `route.ts`, so each basename glob is paired with a `/**` directory form.
